Prevention: Cultivation of early variety of melon.
During ploughing the field the pupa should be collected by hens or other birds.
Collecting of pupa as possible as can during ploughing.
Use plastic mulch in the field.
Bagging of melon while its size is equal to almond.
Removing plant residue from the field after harvesting.
Thinning of fruits to just leave 3-4 melon
Monitoring: Observation of field weekly during sunset while the fruit size is equal to pear
Look for rotting fruits and tiny little holes in the fruit surface
Direct Control: The pupa should be collected during season by hand picking from soil nearby to infected melons
Collection of infested melons and dig those 1 meter deep in the ground far away from the field
Collecting of pupa during ploughing after harvesting of melons
Restrictions: Use protective clothing when spraying to protect your eyes, mouth and skin
Buy chemicals from a certified dealer and keep them out of the reach of children
Do not eat, drink or smoke during the spray
Using of cypermithrin10% EC at the rate of 2 ml / Lit
Use maximum 3 times with one week intervals.
Use maximum 3 times with one week intervals.
